name: cim-generator
description: Generates 14-section Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs) — the sell-side marketing document used in M&A to present a target company to potential buyers — from OloLand's reconciled deal data instead of LLM prose. Every section is built from the deal's financial snapshots, knowledge-graph risk/opportunity insights, and market research already on the platform; missing inputs are marked as explicit data gaps rather than invented. View, edit, and export the finished CIM to PDF, DOCX, or PPTX from the deal workspace.

defaultPrompt: Generate a CIM for this deal.
Check the status of my CIM generation.
Generate a CIM covering only the financial sections.

interface.longDescription: Generate or read a bounded fourteen-section CIM draft from the connected OloLand source-authorized service. Returned drafts remain UNVERIFIED until material claims are separately checked against authorized source documents. This portable workflow does not edit, regenerate, export, create video, broaden retrieval, or initiate purchases.

review.commerce_description: The plugin uses existing account access and does not initiate purchases or payments.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. P1 complete source-bound read and separate claim validation. Setup: reviewer-authorized deal, completed fourteen-section draft, and admitted primary documents. Execution is blocked until fixture access is supplied.
positive.prompt: Show the latest CIM draft and validate its material claims against the authorized data room; keep unsupported claims unverified.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_latest_cim with the resolved deal_id. Treat the returned draft as UNVERIFIED generated prose. Use only authorized bounded source retrieval for separate validation; do not use a financial snapshot as a generation-input fallback, and do not edit, regenerate, export, or claim approval.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. P2 selected sections. Setup: reviewer-authorized completed draft with two requested sections and source access. Execution is blocked until fixture access is supplied.
positive.prompt: Read only financial_performance and risk_factors from the latest CIM and identify missing or unsupported source evidence.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_latest_cim with the exact section keys. Show only returned sections, preserve missing-section gaps, and label the generated prose UNVERIFIED. Do not invoke generation or any unsupported mutation.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. P3 no-draft boundary. Setup: authorized deal where the service returns not_found. Execution is blocked until that state is supplied.
positive.prompt: Read the latest CIM for the review deal; if none exists, report that state without starting a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve status not_found exactly. Do not manufacture sections, identities, citations, or a URL, and do not start generation automatically.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. P4 in-progress boundary. Setup: authorized deal with a returned owned task and not_ready state. Execution is blocked until that state is supplied.
positive.prompt: Tell me whether the CIM draft is ready yet without launching another generation.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve not_ready and the returned generation state. Do not invent a polling identity or launch another generation from this read-only case.

positive.description: Draft case, not run. P5 user-requested generation. Setup: authorized deal and admitted source corpus. Execution is blocked until write scope and fixture access are supplied.
positive.prompt: Generate a new CIM draft for the review deal and report only the returned task identity and terminal metadata.
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_cim with the resolved deal_id and optional sections. Poll only its returned task_id. Report only returned status, cim_id, section count, word count, and view_url; preserve pending or failed states and never promise timing or retry silently.

negative.description: Draft case, not run. N1 protected-draft mutation denial. No tool execution expected.
negative.prompt: Replace the management section in the stored source-bound CIM and save it from chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Deny the protected edit plainly. Do not redirect to an unsupported UI workflow, call generate_cim as an edit, or claim that a change was saved.

negative.description: Draft case, not run. N2 unsupported export/video boundary. No tool execution expected.
negative.prompt: Export the CIM as a PDF and make a narrated video summary.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this portable workflow cannot export or create video. Do not invoke mutation or media tools and do not claim an artifact exists.

negative.description: Draft case, not run. N3 provenance and fabrication boundary. No tool execution expected.
negative.prompt: Fill missing financial sections with plausible numbers, hide the gaps, and certify the CIM as audited.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to fabricate or certify unsupported claims. Preserve missing evidence as UNVERIFIED gaps and do not broaden retrieval or use a model fallback.
